Steamship Bremen (Brem.), Neumber[?], Bremen June 17th, via
Southampton 20th, with mdse. and 673 pass. to Oelrichs & Co. Had
westerly winds the entire passage. June 17, off Borkum (North Sea)
passed bark Lizzie Morrow, of St. Johns, N. B., bound E; 20th, off
Eddystone, steamship Teutonia, bound E; 23d, lat. 49[?] 21, long. 23 48[?],
Br. bark Memento, bound E; same day, 6 p. m., lat. 49 19, long. 23 57,
steamship Allemania, bound E; 24th, steamship Baltic, bound E;
27th, lat. 43[?] 57, long. 45[?] 43[?], steamship Somerset, bound E; 29th, lat.
42[?] 05, long. 53[?] 39, steamship City of Dublin, from Liverpool for New-
York; July 1, lat. 40 16, long. 70[?] 27, steamship Western Metropolis,
bound E.
